## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] No em-dashes, smart quotes, or AI-sounding copy in code, UI, docs, or commit messages

- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot
- [ ] Anything security-sensitive was handled per SECURITY.md, not in a public PR
